goal: Public API review: what a library or service exposes, and whether it can change safely.
use: Public API review: what a library or service exposes, and whether it can change safely. Use when a public type, function or endpoint is added or changed.

steps.note: List the public surface. Exported types, functions and endpoints.
Check minimality. Flag exposed members that callers do not need.
Check stability. Flag changes to existing signatures, names or behaviour.
Check documentation. Each public item needs a stated contract.
Report. Each item with file and line, the change, and whether it breaks callers.
